title: TrimEditor
description: A GUI plugin to apply and remove Armor Trims in Minecraft 1.21+
body:
## Overview
TrimEditor provides a clean, two-step graphical interface for players to manage Armor Trims without requiring a Smithing Table or template items. It is designed specifically for Minecraft 1.21+ environments with a strict focus on maintaining server performance.

**! Not suitable for survival servers. Users can edit without materials or a smithing table**

## Core Features

- Two-Step GUI: Separate menus for choosing patterns and materials.
- Instant Removal: One-click button to clear trims from armor.
- Lag-Free: Pre-cached menus for instant loading without affecting server performance.
- Custom Sounds: Configurable audio for clicks, success, and errors.
- Vanilla Look: Uses default Minecraft item names and lore

## Commands and Permissions

- /trim (or /trimeditor) | trimeditor.use : Opens the customization GUI for the armor piece currently held in the main hand.
- /trim reload | trimeditor.admin : Reloads the configuration file and rebuilds the interface cache.

## System Requirements

- Server Software: Spigot, Paper, Purpur, or compatible forks
- Minecraft Version: 1.21 or higher
- Java: Java 21 or higher
